status: sensitivity analysis, post hoc; the amend7 exp5 output is not changed
method: DrugBank lookup with the preregistered resolution of ddiood.drugbank.validate on the 2,810 SemEval 2013 test pairs; score 1 if DrugBank lists the pair; pooled AUROC against the binary SemEval label with a bootstrap over sentences; a self pair names the same drug on both sides (case and space normalised)
